analysis.insight_summary: Users discovered that the [product_name] Web Editor does not work with [product_name] [version_no] (or related models with firmware like [version_no]). No firmware updates can add this compatibility, causing uncertainty about which hardware versions support the tool. There is demand for clearer documentation and compatibility lists. The lack of support leads to user disappointment.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to use the [product_name] Web Editor with [product_name] [version_no] and similar hardware, and are searching for thorough training materials—especially for networking and internet use.
